collection.description: A child wonders why one family prays before meals while another does not.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (child) wonders why one family prays before meals while another does not.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (adult) says prayer is meaningful to some people.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (child) learns that gratitude can also be expressed without prayer.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (elder) explains a family custom without expecting agreement.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (elder) admits that different people pray for different reasons.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (adult), a teacher, explains that some people do not believe in gods or spirits.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (child) learns that nonbelievers can still be kind and thoughtful.
